decisions: APR and BHF-BBB2 inputs include BPS outer crust plus SLy4 inner crust; strip that pre-matched crust from core-only construction.
GM1 includes Douchin-Haensel crust below 1.0e-3 fm^-3; this boundary is explicit on its CompOSE source page.
KDE0v1 and SLy4 inputs are unified EOS tables; homogeneous core onset must be resolved from their model-specific phase dictionaries and data sheets.
CompOSE mn/mp/Il header and Q1-Q7 convention are retained; Q6/Q7 are normalized with source mn, not hard-coded mass.
Iphase is a per-EOS categorical label; missing composition remains missing.
Raw source, normalized source, reconstructed source, standalone component and matched composite are distinct immutable artifact classes.
GPPVA_TW uses BPS below 2.0e-3 fm^-3, not BSk22; source page 212.
GPPVA_FSU2R outer-crust provider remains unverified and is not inferred from the family.
The archived APR 172-point input is page 68; newer 1833-point page 328 is a different release and is not substituted.
